Tessa (People Ops): Quick FYI: Maya (new PM) says passport renewal delayed and can't visit US office within 3 business days. Need plan for I-9 and day-1 access.
Ben (Hiring Manager): Can she start remotely? We had planned an in-person lunch but remote is fine if ops supports it.
Maya (New Hire): Hi all 1 thanks. I can meet a local notary in Toronto or use an authorized agent. Also my home wifi is spotty; I'd prefer a company laptop.
Tessa (People Ops): Notary or I-9 verification partner both work. We'll cover vendor fee. Please upload a photo of your passport + renewal receipt to secure intake.
verifications-bot: @Maya secure upload link: https://redwood-internal/onboard-upload (expires 72h).
Maya (New Hire): Uploaded passport scan and renewal queue receipt. Notary: Toronto Notary Services, King St.
IT-bot: Please confirm shipping address for loaner. Standard domestic ship to Canada ~3 business days. If urgent, we can expedite.
Maya (New Hire): Shipping: 88 King St W, Unit 1205, Toronto, ON M5H 1A3. Expedited please.
Tessa (People Ops): Actions: 1) Tessa to send Agent Authorization template + vendor list; 2) IT to ship loaner (ticket IT-6119) and send Okta invite; 3) Benefits walkthrough scheduled within first week; 4) Payroll to send Canadian tax residency info.
Ben (Hiring Manager): I'll approve remote day-1. Team will do virtual lunch.
Maya (New Hire): Thanks everyone, appreciate the help.
verifications-bot: Reminder sent: "Complete I-9 agent visit" scheduled +2 days.
